tasks.title: Pair-product generator telescoping derivation: does H-CREP-001's mechanism telescope like known linear factors, or is there a derived obstruction?

handoff.objective: Derive, on the frozen P1553 instance model, whether H-CREP-001's pair-product generators telescope under the elliptic-curve group law the way a product of known linear factors telescopes under polynomial multiplication; route a genuine trigger through the amended gate if telescoping holds, or build a derived (not asserted) structural obstruction argument, passing docs/inventor-protocol.md Section 8's audits and a fresh proves-too-much control, if it does not.

inputs: docs/inventor-protocol.md (Section 8's proof-architecture portfolio governs any structural argument produced)

ledger/goals/GOAL-ECDLP-001/goal.yaml (the live next_action opening this task in full, and the amended gate at preadmission_gate_g2_g8_wording_amendment_20260830 -- route any found trigger through THIS amended wording, not the pre-amendment text)

constraints: This is a non-batch, zero-experiment (or at most trivial hand-computable sanity checks, no computer algebra system, no program execution) analytical derivation task. Do not create B71, BATCH, IDEA, EV, DEC, CORR, experiment, or implementation records. Do not change H-CREP-001's status or EXP-CREP-001's specification -- name a candidate constructor or a derived obstruction; a Coordinator decision, not this task, would act on either.

State the pair-product generators' combination rule EXPLICITLY on the frozen instance model (deck sizes B in {2,3}, six strata) -- write down the actual objects (what a generator is, what pairing two generators produces, what data is needed to perform the combination) rather than describing them abstractly or by analogy to the classical linear-factors case. If H-CREP-001.yaml does not fully specify enough detail to do this precisely, say exactly what is missing and how far the derivation can be carried before that gap is hit -- an honest partial derivation with a named gap is a valid and useful outcome, not a failure to hide.

The telescoping question is precise: for a product of n known linear factors (x - a_1)...(x - a_n), the remainder-tree/subproduct-tree technique combines two subproducts of sizes k and n-k in time roughly proportional to their sizes (not to n or to the product of their sizes), which is exactly what makes the overall reduction quasi-linear rather than quadratic or cubic. Determine whether combining two pair-product generators in H-CREP-001's mechanism has this same locality property, or whether it requires information/work that grows with the combined or total size in a way the classical case does not. State the answer as a concrete cost statement (e.g. 'combining generators covering strata subsets S1 and S2 costs O(f(|S1|,|S2|))' with f stated exactly), not a qualitative impression.

If telescoping is found to hold (path A): name the exact resulting candidate constructor for r_R mod g_I, and discharge it against EVERY item of the amended gate text at preadmission_gate_g2_g8_wording_amendment_20260830 in ledger/goals/GOAL-ECDLP-001/goal.yaml (read that exact amended wording, not the pre-amendment G2/G8 text) -- public construction from E, P, Q alone, no roots/factors/witnesses/support tables/source enumeration (as clarified by the amendment), full cost enumeration within budget, lineage/multiplicity preservation, Q vs -Q, output-sensitive unranking, and the amended already-costed-route exclusion. A candidate that discharges every amended gate item is a genuine typed trigger; record it as such with the exact construction.

If a named, measured obstruction to telescoping is found (path B): state it as a specific, checkable claim (a per-generator or per-combination cost that is provably superlinear in the relevant parameter, or an explicit non-associativity/non-locality property of the combination rule) -- not a restatement of 'it doesn't seem to telescope.' This obstruction is the first mechanism-level ingredient for a structural argument. That argument must then independently pass docs/inventor-protocol.md Section 8's four audits (exact baseline reproduction of what it claims to establish, observation-collision search against EV-CRYPTO-002 and all prior rounds including the gate-framing review's own dichotomy attempt, quantifier-order statement, method ceiling) AND a FRESH proves-too-much control run against the same subproduct-tree/known-linear-factors nearby object used in the gate-framing review -- but this time addressing directly and explicitly why the P1553 generators' asymmetry from that classical object is DERIVED from the stated combination-rule cost, not merely asserted as a premise. This is the exact gap the prior gate-framing review's dichotomy attempt failed to close (see gate-calibration-analysis.yaml / framing-revisit-analysis.yaml and preadmission_gate_framing_review_terminal_note_20260830); do not repeat it.

Either path, or an honest partial-derivation-with-named-gap outcome if neither A nor B can be reached, must explain concretely why EXP-CREP-001's ROUTE-04 (multipoint evaluation) and ROUTE-07 (subresultant/half-gcd) -- both first_failed V3 with a declared online exponent of exactly 3 per execution-report.yaml's predicate_matrix -- measured that Theta(B^3) cost instead of the quasi-linear cost the classical technique achieves for a generic known-linear-factors product. Anchor this explanation to the actual derivation, not to a restatement of the empirical measurement alone.

No commands, programs, experiments, benchmarks, or computer algebra system execution. Small, explicit hand-worked or symbolically-reasoned examples on the frozen instance model (e.g. B=2, a specific small stratum count) are permitted and encouraged if they make the combination rule concrete, provided they are shown as reasoning steps, not run as code.

Controls before belief: any claimed telescoping or obstruction result must be checked against a degenerate or boundary case (e.g. the smallest nontrivial deck size, or a stratum count of 1) to catch an error in the general derivation before it is recorded as general.

Citation provenance is mandatory. Every source carries recalled | retrieved | kb | internal. A recalled source is a pointer telling a reviewer where to look and can never back a claim until retrieved and read by an authorized agent in a new record.

Write the four substantive artifacts first and runtime-session-receipt.json last. Do not alter any input, goal, ledger, prior pre-admission, prior round, or queue file. YAML hygiene is mandatory and will be independently re-checked with a strict parser (Gate 6): no plain scalar may contain an embedded, unescaped double-quote or a colon-followed-by-space -- wrap the ENTIRE scalar in single quotes if either is needed. No duplicated top-level keys at any nesting level. This exact defect class has broken artifacts in three of the last four rounds; check every free-text field before finishing.
